terms: AEP
Artifact Exchange Protocol — coordinates requests, responses and artifacts through a shared distributed state machine.
AI Assistant
Creates Model-First package1 from the human task and explicitly supplied contracts and artifacts.
AI Worker
Performs its authorized application role, such as Code-First generation, runtime testing or evidence analysis.
Application Role
Defines the meaning, permitted execution and interpretation of application requests above the exchange protocol.
AppLog
Browser client for device communication, script operations and runtime observation; the AI Worker Toolbar provides AEP integration.
ctx
Context identifier carried through commands, events and packets; it correlates an operation and is not authentication.
DDR
Metadata declaration structured into Design, Deployment and Runtime sections: intent, target bindings and execution context.
Deployment Zero Patch
Explicit whole-file target replacements applied after placement and before compilation, pending integration into a new accepted pair.
EMPTY
Minimal reusable agile business module and a foundation for defining custom modules.
Event
Published occurrence delivered to matching subscriptions, with its context and arguments.
Golden Pair
Accepted reusable Model-First / Code-First baseline retained unchanged, including its declared validation scope.
HAL
Hardware Abstraction Layer — platform and physical resource bindings resolved for the selected target.
Increment
Requested delta against an explicit baseline; unaffected implementation artifacts remain byte-identical.
LAR
Logical Artifacts Repository — addressable artifacts, contracts, implementations, packages and evidence with provenance.
LORA
Agile module exposing LoRa communication through declared commands and events.
MAL
Metadata Access Layer — the declared access surface through which a module's capabilities are described and composed.
Message
Command and arguments routed to a module endpoint under a supplied context.
Metadata Connector
Binds logical metadata to runtime composition and selected platform/resource configuration.
Module
Independent reusable unit with explicit contracts, message handlers and event interfaces; it can participate in a communication chain.
Module Contract
Three agile artifacts — README.md, _at.json and _module.json — declaring a module's capabilities and rules for plugging it into the communication chain.
package0
Logical task collection: human requirements, diagrams and other declared input artifacts for Model-First generation.
package1
Complete Model-First declarations for a concrete target, including selected module contracts and target bindings.
package12
Verified package1 + package2 pair with provenance and validation evidence; a trained module or module composition reusable at the business application level within its declared scope.
package2
Code-First realization of the corresponding package1, with deployment artifacts and recorded validation state.
Placer
Guides placement of Code-First artifacts into the target development project, dependencies, build and device deployment.
Provenance
Recorded origin, baseline, decisions, hashes and evidence linking an artifact to its preceding states.
RKB
Runtime Knowledge Base — instrumented observations captured from execution and preserved as evidence for analysis and validation.
Runtime Composition
Creation, configuration and connection of module instances into the selected runtime container and communication chain.
Semaphore
Shared leased blob representing the distributed AEP state machine; the current implementation uses Azure Blob Storage.
Subscription
Declared producer/consumer route with a topic, filter and delivery mode governing event delivery.
SYS
Agile module providing system and board resources such as NEO, LED, Button, Flash and timers/watchdogs.
TraceLog
Instrumented runtime record describing context, module, operation and result; part of the observed RKB.
uLAR / microLAR
Portable micro Logical Artifacts Repository containing an explicitly packaged collection of artifacts and its state.
WDG
Watchdog — supervised deadline that expires unless an authorized operation cancels, retriggers or atomically confirms it under its declared contract.
